This does not mean that people automatically adopt the role assigned to them by family and society.
The concept of role has been applied to describe how people act in families, and in organizations such as work places.

These roles expectations were reinforced by the traditional hierarchy of academic power within universities, which had been maintained through such institutions as faculty appointments and rewards for research achievements.
The idea of the model role, like the idea of the ‘real’ role model itself, is not the product of social science but of fiction writing, the novel and drama.
